data.name: Maruti
data.long_meaning: Maruti is a name derived from the Hindu god Hanuman, who is also known as Maruti. The name signifies the god as the lord of the winds, as he is believed to be the swift messenger of Lord Rama. Maruti is also considered the god of knowledge and wisdom.
